description: Whether the person's account has credits for the paid steps (recording the voice, starting a story, music, voice spaces, exports). Shows them a card with their video's look and title on top, then the plans, each opening its checkout on fuzzframe.com, and an "I've paid" button (where their chat shows cards). Call it at the first paid step when the guide says the account has no plan or no credits (in place of that step, with the brief's look and title), and when a paid step answers that there are no credits.

look.description: The brief's look id (a motion look, story:<id> or the story look's id, or my-…), so the card shows it

title.description: The video's title, as its cover headline reads

name: plan
title: Show the plans
